fact: The Banco de Cabo Verde page states that payment services and the issue, distribution and redemption of electronic money are regulated by Decreto-legislativo n.º 8/2018 of 28 November 2018.

The page states that payment institutions and e-money institutions, financial institutions distinct from banks, are authorised by the Banco de Cabo Verde under Decreto-legislativo n.º 9/2018, and that Correios de Cabo Verde may also issue e-money; it names no licensee and gives the page date 2025-01-01 only as its published date.

Decreto-legislativo n.º 7/2018 of 28 November 2018, promulgated 25 November 2018, sets the legal regime for the regulation, management and operation of the Cabo Verdean payment system, requires authorisation by the Banco de Cabo Verde to provide payment services or operate a system (art. 15), and enters into force thirty days after publication.

The same Boletim Oficial n.º 78 of 28 November 2018 publishes Decreto-legislativo n.º 8/2018, the regime for payment services and the issue, distribution and reimbursement of electronic money in Cabo Verde by legally authorised entities; its entry-into-force provision is not in the text held, so the date is the bulletin's publication date.
